name: sadies-dropper-world
description: Sadie's Clubhouse: a lost 90s shareware activity center, Sadie's mansion with a room per activity (Sadie's Dropper World, TypeFitter Deluxe 3.1, Brickbuster '96, the Music Room, the aquarium, Space Adventure), the Hedge Maze beside it, and Clyde's House and Chooter's Paint Shop outside the gate.
